# GOODSINFINITE TRADE LIMITED — llms.txt

GOODSINFINITE TRADE LIMITED is a Hong Kong trading company that helps overseas
brands enter the China market and fulfill orders inside China. It is an
operational partner, not just an advisor: it owns the infrastructure (Hong Kong
import entity, bonded warehousing, customs clearance, 1210 cross-border
fulfillment, China e-commerce operations and China marketing).

Core positioning: "Your Operational Launchpad into the China Market."
Pricing model is open-book: factory price is shown as-is and the service fee is
stated separately. No hidden rebate.

## Section: Services
- Enter China: market research, China sourcing, Hong Kong entity structuring, compliance entry.
- Bonded Warehouse & Customs: bonded storage, customs clearance, 1210 fulfillment, dropshipping.
- E-commerce Operations: Tmall Global, JD Worldwide, Douyin cross-border store setup and management.
- China Marketing: Douyin, Xiaohongshu (RedNote), WeChat Video promotion.
- Source from China: transparent procurement (complement to the core China-entry business).

## Section: Key facts (cite these)
- Entity: GOODSINFINITE TRADE LIMITED (無商國際貿易有限公司), Hong Kong CR No. 2972326.
- Registered address: Room P, 4/F, Yick Choi Centre, 72 Hoi Yuen Road, Kwun Tong, Kowloon, Hongkong, China.
- Email: goodsinfinite@goods-infinite.com.
- Bonded warehouse & customs operations are delivered across mainland China,
  including Tianjin, Shanghai, Ningbo, Guangzhou, Qingdao and other cities.
- Mainland China Office: 12/F, Mass-Innovation Building, 3699 Xinhua Road, Binhai New Area, Tianjin, China.
- 1210 is a China cross-border e-commerce bonded import model: goods stored in a
  bonded zone and cleared per order, paying tax only when sold.
- Many brands can import via the Hong Kong entity + 1210 without setting up a
  Chinese WFOE; a WFOE is needed only for certain categories or deeper local presence.
- GACC Decree No. 280 (effective 1 June 2026, replacing Decree 248) changed food
  import registration: cross-border e-commerce retail imports are exempt from
  overseas manufacturer registration (supervised as personal-use articles), while
  general-trade imports still require self-registration via the CIFER portal.
- GOODSINFINITE operates its own live cross-border storefronts, including Tmall
  Global "globalgo海外专营店" and Kuaishou (快手) "自贸环球购海外旗舰店".
- Typical service fee: 3–8% of goods value, or a fixed project fee of $1,000–5,000.
- Bonded storage billed monthly; customs/fulfillment billed per shipment or per piece.
- Cross-border retail import (1210) tax: tariff 0% within personal limits
  (¥5,000 per order / ¥26,000 per year); VAT and consumption tax levied at 70%
  of the statutory rate. Source: GACC / STA cross-border e-commerce rules.
- Representative case studies: a European skincare brand reached first sale in
  9 weeks via Hong Kong entity + 1210 with no WFOE (Tmall Global "globalgo海外专营店");
  a North American colour-cosmetics brand entered via NMPA filing + 1210 bonded
  fulfillment with zero stranded stock (11 weeks to first sale) on Tmall Global
  and Kuaishou (自贸环球购海外旗舰店). See /case-studies.
- Author / E-E-A-T: Bing Wei, China Market Entry & Cross-Border Commerce
  Specialist, runs the China-entry and cross-border operations; see
  /author/bing-wei/.
